name: Lebanon
famous_for: Roman temples of Baalbek, ancient Phoenician port of Byblos (oldest inhabited city), cedar trees, and gourmet mezze cuisine.
tourists: Over 1.9M tourists annually; famous for Jeita Grotto crystal caves, Pigeon Rocks in Raouche, and Byblos harbor.
must_know: The cedar tree (Cedrus libani) has been prized since biblical times and stands as the proud central emblem on Lebanon's flag.
fun_fact: Byblos in Lebanon is believed to have been continuously inhabited for over 7,000 years, and gave its name to the word 'Bible'.
